item.title: About Amit
item.description: Hi, I’m Amit Sharma. I build digital products, help founders build better ones, and spend a lot of time thinking about how technology changes the way we solve problems. Over the last 18 years, I’ve worked across fintech, insurance, wealth management, education, consumer products, and SaaS. My career has taken me from large organizations like ICICI Securities to high-growth startups like Coverfox, and today to working independently as a fractional product leader, startup advisor, mentor, and educator.
